stories.title: Doctors warn of physical limits as China viral ‘flash step’ dance sends imitators to hospital

en.title: Doctors warn of physical limits as China viral 'flash step' dance sends imitators to hospital
en.summary: A viral dance trend featuring rapid side-to-side movements called the 'flash step' has prompted widespread imitations across Chinese social media, with some people requiring hospital treatment due to physical strain from the movements.

en.title: Former Chongqing mayor Huang Qifan under investigation for corruption
en.summary: Huang Qifan, the former mayor of Chongqing, faces investigation by China's Communist Party discipline body for alleged serious violations of discipline and law.

en.title: Former Chongqing Party Deputy Secretary and Mayor Huang Qifan under investigation
en.summary: Huang Qifan, former deputy secretary of Chongqing's party committee and former mayor, is under disciplinary review and investigation for alleged serious violations of party discipline and law.

stories.title: Is Indonesia’s haze rhetoric ‘unempathetic’? Oxygen quip tests regional cooperation

en.title: Is Indonesia's haze rhetoric 'unempathetic'? Oxygen quip tests regional cooperation
en.summary: An Indonesian government official's comments characterizing the country's forest fire emissions as 'oxygen' exports have drawn criticism for appearing dismissive of regional haze concerns and potentially damaging efforts to address recurring transboundary air pollution.

stories.title: China’s Zhuhai air show to feature first-ever dedicated naval equipment display

en.title: China's Zhuhai air show to feature first-ever dedicated naval equipment display
en.summary: China's biennial Zhuhai air show will showcase a dedicated naval equipment exhibition for the first time, displaying active-duty hardware from the country's navy as part of the event's 30th anniversary celebration.

en.summary: Hong Kong's autumn electronics product exhibition has opened, featuring a new future industries pavilion showcasing robots and other advanced technology products to visitors.

stories.title: Bulgaria seeks Nato support after Black Sea drone strikes hit merchant ships, sinking 1

en.title: Bulgaria seeks Nato support after Black Sea drone strikes hit merchant ships, sinking 1
en.summary: Drone strikes hit two merchant vessels off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, sinking one and damaging another. All 15 crew members from the sunken ship were evacuated, with some receiving treatment for minor injuries.

en.summary: Researchers at Qinghai University's biotechnology institute have successfully harvested over 3 million micro-potatoes in Xining, Qinghai province.

en.title: Man does pull-ups on ancient beam at Hanging Temple; scenic area reports public security has filed case
en.summary: A video circulated online showing a man performing pull-ups on an ancient wooden beam at the Hanging Temple. The Hengshan scenic area management center initiated an emergency response and coordinated with relevant departments to investigate and handle the incident.

en.summary: Business representatives from Russia and Kazakhstan visited a pastoral company in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia to study dairy farming practices, including inquiries about grassland area calculations and management methods.

stories.title: China, Russia deepen maritime and Arctic logistics ties to secure energy supply

en.title: China, Russia deepen maritime and Arctic logistics ties to secure energy supply
en.summary: China and Russia committed to strengthening maritime and logistical cooperation during talks between their foreign and maritime officials. The agreement aims to protect shipping routes and energy supplies while advancing each nation's maritime interests.

stories.title: China-Botswana economic ties deepen as cooperation drives development

en.title: China-Botswana economic ties deepen as cooperation drives development
en.summary: China-Botswana trade reached 1.222 billion dollars in 2025, increasing 21.3 percent year-on-year. The nations are expanding cooperation in trade, investment, and technology with projects delivering mutual economic and social benefits.

en.summary: Sun Hung Kai Properties has transformed the former Crowne Plaza hotel in Tseung Kwan O into the Royal Garden Kowloon East, repositioning it as a luxury urban resort to attract a new generation of tourists to Hong Kong.

stories.title: PBOC adds most gold in three years amid China pivot from US dollar

en.title: PBOC adds most gold in three years amid China pivot from US dollar
en.summary: China's central bank increased its gold reserves by 740,000 troy ounces in September, the largest addition in three years, as it reduces its exposure to US dollar assets amid US-China tensions.

en.title: Chinese billionaire featured in 'American Factory' shares lesson for firms going global
en.summary: Fuyao Glass founder Cao Dewang advised Chinese companies expanding internationally to respect local laws, regulations and culture, citing this approach as central to his firm's success in the US market.

en.summary: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission suspended trading in Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial, the third stock suspension in a month, reflecting increased regulatory scrutiny over listed company quality.

en.title: Why Haidilao's US$14.9 million credit line to founder is fuelling China tax speculation
en.summary: Haidilao International Holding has extended a one-month loan of up to 100 million yuan to founder Zhang Yong. The move has sparked investor speculation regarding Beijing's October 22 deadline for offshore trust taxation.
